name: Fire Plume Forged
summary: At Fire Plume Ridge, fierce heat can forge the stem of a skeletal key. Krinkle Goodsteel sends you to the volcano west in Un'Goro Crater, where a lava lake crowns its summit. You then carry the stem to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: Fire for the Key Stem
sections.body: Two bars of thorium and fierce heat are needed to forge the key stem. You find the thorium, and Krinkle Goodsteel helps provide the heat. Your gold has bought a mold, ready for the lava lake atop Fire Plume Ridge. There, lava fuses thorium and bone together.

sections.title: Back to Dithers
sections.body: Krinkle Goodsteel has done their part. Now you return to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands to finish the key. The stem forged in lava remains unfinished, and this work prepares for an assault.

sections.title: What Lies Ahead
sections.body: Apothecary Dithers calls the key costly, though it remains unfinished. All this work is aimed at a foe in Andorhal: Araj the Summoner, a lich ranked among the most powerful of the Scourge.

faq.q: Where is the key stem forged?
faq.answer: You forge the key stem in the lava lake atop Fire Plume Ridge, a simmering volcano in Un'Goro Crater, west of Krinkle Goodsteel.

faq.q: What is needed to forge the key stem?
faq.answer: You need a skeleton key mold and two bars of thorium. You find the thorium yourself.
Apothecary Dithers receives the unfinished key at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.
